header.title: Contact & feedback
header.subtitle: A bug, an idea, a question? Write to us, we read everything.

bug.label: Bug
bug.placeholder: E.g. after my set, the rest timer doesn't start…
bug.guidance: Give the steps to reproduce, what you expected, and your phone model — it helps us fix it fast.
bug.successLine: Got it — we're heading over to take a close look at this bug.

feature.label: Idea
feature.placeholder: E.g. being able to duplicate an existing template…
feature.guidance: Above all, describe the need behind the idea: what would it let you do?
feature.successLine: Great idea, thanks! We're adding it to our thinking.

general.label: Message
general.placeholder: Your question, your opinion or your feedback…
general.guidance: A question, a remark, some encouragement: we read every message.
general.successLine: Thanks for your message. We take the time to read every piece of feedback.

other.label: Other
other.guidance: Give us as much context as possible so we can help you as best we can.
other.successLine: Thanks for your message. We'll get back to you if needed.
